prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Move sign-in step to after picking or creating a pet so users form an emotional attachment before signing in. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right away, and 8 support tickets report pet loss after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Live Desktop Pet Preview & Creation Studio: Redesign the photo upload step into a two-column live preview studio with photo quality tips and pet rendering feedback. (why: Adoption step drops 39.1% of users with high mean time (1017s), and 3 support emails reported failed or strange custom pets.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough: Add a dedicated controls walkthrough screen explaining how to summon, move, talk to, and hide the desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple complaints from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Playpen While Waiting: Transform the static waiting screen into an interactive desktop playpen where users can play with pet toys during setup. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing heavy user drop-off right before completion.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines & Quality Checklist: Display explicit photo quality rules and a recommendation badge during custom pet photo upload. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visual results.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic & Ready Alert: Add desktop visibility troubleshooting tips and background completion notification toggles to the generation waiting screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet not displaying on desktop after setup, alongside high waiting times.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Animated Desktop Mascot App Intro: Add an animated mascot preview with clear value promise copy to the initial app intro screen. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%, requiring stronger initial visual pull on screen 1.)

scores.note: Moving sign-in after value creation directly addresses the 27.1% sign-in drop and 8 support tickets.
Targets the highest drop step (39.1%) and reported pet creation bugs, but requires a full studio redesign.
Helps clarify pet controls for confused users, though adding a new screen increases finish step friction.
Engages users during long generation wait times (mean 2336s), but building interactive playpen is costly.
Low-cost guidelines directly targeting the 39.1% adoption drop and photo upload error support emails.
Solves desktop visibility bugs reported in 3 tickets while easing drop-off from long waiting times.
Initial intro screen already converts relatively well (76.2%); animated copy provides minor value pull.
